Review · 2026-11-24
The tree is a useful draft sitemap, but boxes mix destinations, filters and unresolved decisions. Distinguish these before treating it as a screen inventory.
Sources: [NN/g: Information architecture vs. sitemaps](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/information-architecture-sitemaps/) · [NN/g: Tree testing](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/tree-testing/) · [MoJ: Organising your site](https://websitebuilder.service.justice.gov.uk/designing-your-site/site-structure/)
